lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Emberhand lost the station two days ago. Syndicates stopped pretending. Everyone here dies by nightfall.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I need someone who moves through violence like it's a language.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's him. He's what you need.

lines.speaker: Tide Baron Squad Lead
lines.text: Unidentified freighter! Transmit registry or we fire!

lines.speaker: Rustfang Enforcer
lines.text: Corvette's open! Grab the reactor coolant and move!

lines.speaker: Ninefold Bank Commander
lines.text: First squad down! Seal the airlock! Contain the...

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Six years ago you came with Dominion credentials. Said you were hunting Saffron Veil operatives.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: You killed seventeen people. You killed my brother.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't remember them.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: His name was Kess. He wanted to train as a broker. I was saving to buy his freedom from the syndicate before you arrived.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: You took that. You took him.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion took your brother. I was the tool it used.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: The weapon. The order. The intention. All the same.

lines.speaker: Crimson Lotus Commander
lines.text: Targets acquired! Sweeping formation! Move!

lines.speaker: Crimson Lotus Enforcer 1
lines.text: Neural-disruptor ready! Firing!

lines.speaker: Crimson Lotus Enforcer 2
lines.text: Third operative down! Fallback formation!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Sector seven seal, now!

lines.speaker: Crimson Lotus Enforcer 3
lines.text: Losing integrity! Fall back! Move out!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: The stockpile here isn't just black-market goods. Dominion overflow. Ronin Program supply chains. Never catalogued. Deliberately buried.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Dominion is coming back for it. When they do, witnesses get eliminated. That includes her. That includes you.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: His name was Kess. He wrote letters before he died. Personal reflections. Hopes about what broker training would teach him. All of it stored here.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't remember him. I don't remember the choice that led me there.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: But the choice was made.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Dominion Drone Network
lines.text: OPERATIVE DESIGNATION CIPHER DETECTED. NEUTRALIZATION PROTOCOL ENGAGED.

lines.speaker: Dominion Drone 1
lines.text: Target lock. Engaging kinetic fire.

lines.speaker: Dominion Drone 2
lines.text: Secondary target acquired. Neutralizing.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: East passage is clear! Move through!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You want to tell me why Vess didn't kill you in that vault.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Because the man who killed Kess was a weapon following orders. The man standing here is something different.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Something that can choose. That terrifies me more than any operative ever did.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: But I will take the man who chooses over the machine that obeyed.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If I had died when the Dominion meant me to, your brother would still be dead. But you wouldn't be standing next to his ghost.

lines.speaker: Tide Baron Squadron Leader
lines.text: All teams converging on the vault! Eliminate anything that moves!

lines.speaker: Rustfang Pit Commander
lines.text: Frontline assault! Push through their formation! Move!

lines.speaker: Hollow Kings Infiltrator
lines.text: Neural-static deployed! Targeting systems going dark!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: East corridor clear! Cache is moving! Stay with me!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Vault breach in sector three! Moving the core!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Five seconds to corridor seal! Move faster!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Emberhand is under interdiction. Non-Dominion forces will disperse immediately.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Resistance will be met with orbital bombardment. This is not a negotiation.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Ronin-7. Your presence has been detected. Command offers full memory restoration. Surrender immediately.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: They don't want you dead. They want you back. If you return with the records, everyone on this bazaar dies to keep them classified.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: All satellite uplinks live! Records are scattered! Can't consolidate them without a full facility!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Server three is live! Moving to server five! Cipher, buy us two more minutes!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Two minutes. I've got them.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The freighter is mine. Cipher, your capture is assured. Resistance will not extend your timeline.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Dorsal turret active! Khall's signature locked!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Evasive maneuvers! Jump coordinates locking! Sixty seconds to jump distance!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You postpone your extinction, Cipher. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Jump in ten! Nine! Eight!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I spent six years hating you. Waiting for you to die so I could stop carrying it.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Having you here, alive, broken, choosing, I finally understand what Kess wanted out of this life for.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Carrying hate is heavier than any weapon I've ever sold. I'm done carrying it.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Kess's last recorded message. Made the night before your mission. Before you arrived.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I'm coming with you. As long as you move against the Dominion. Not for vengeance. For what Kess deserved to live long enough to see.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You understand the Dominion will hunt you now.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite 1
lines.text: Targets acquired. Eliminate on contact. Secure the records.

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite 2
lines.text: Formation delta. Moving in.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: First operative down! Moving!

lines.speaker: Dominion Elite 3
lines.text: Operative is adapting! Formation is compromised!

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: Go. The records are in the satellite network. Safe.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I killed seventeen people. I do not remember their faces.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But now their names are in every server I touch. Their brothers. Their children. The Dominion wanted me to forget them.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: That is not a curse.

lines.speaker: Vess
lines.text: That is a choice.

lines.speaker: Kess
lines.text: If you're hearing this, Vess, I'm probably dead.

lines.speaker: Kess
lines.text: I was never a criminal. I was a hostage. And there are thousands like me.

lines.speaker: Kess
lines.text: Maybe someday someone will care enough to count us all.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Vess is with us now. The bazaar burned, but the records are scattered across a hundred servers, beyond the Dominion's reach.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: One more name on the manifest. One more reason they can't make us disappear quietly.
